init.title: Per-item financial sensors
init.description: Optional: expose selected financial names and numeric values to Home Assistant entities, recorder and automations. None keeps each metric disabled. All and Selected share the entity cap (maximum 100). Forecasts use the configured window (default 90 days). Payday details require authorised employment access; private payroll inputs suppress shared forecasts.
